verses.english: “Mendicants, I will teach you seven principles that prevent decline.
Listen and apply your mind well …

verses.pali: katame ca, bhikkhave, satta aparihāniyā dhammā?
verses.english: And what are the seven principles that prevent decline?

verses.pali: Yāvakīvañca, bhikkhave, bhikkhū satisambojjhaṅgaṁ bhāvessanti; vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṁ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
verses.english: As long as the mendicants develop the awakening factor of mindfulness …

verses.pali: upekkhāsambojjhaṅgaṁ bhāvessanti; vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṁ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihāni.
verses.english: equanimity, they can expect growth, not decline.

verses.pali: Yāvakīvañca, bhikkhave, ime satta aparihāniyā dhammā bhikkhūsu ṭhassanti, imesu ca sattasu aparihāniyesu dhammesu bhikkhū sandississanti; vuddhiyeva, bhikkhave, bhikkhūnaṁ pāṭikaṅkhā, no parihānī”ti.
verses.english: As long as these seven principles that prevent decline last among the mendicants, and as long as the mendicants are seen following them, they can expect growth, not decline.”
